name: Dalmatian Islands Environment Foundation grants
summary: Grants for local organisations and bodies running habitat and biodiversity conservation, regenerative land use and resource management projects across the Dalmatian islands, with a focus on capacity building and local participation.

applicant_types.quote: Local non-profit organisations, associations, clubs or unions, social cooperative enterprises and/or other local bodies, including research centres, are all welcome to apply for DIEF grants.

geography.quote: DIEF encourages the implementation of projects across the entire Dalmatian archipelago.

access.quote: All applicants need to complete and submit our application form.
